command_detail: Each results.json records the exact emcc arguments. Standalone C stubs link the actual JS library with native Wasm exceptions, real posix_memalign and matching minimal self-installing version-2 protocol fixtures; no CoreCLR runtime is linked.
checks: Real native-to-JS callback and JS-to-native posix_memalign arguments
Full poisoned pointer output slot and int64_t size overwritten correctly
Four payload bytes installed into native heap and read by C
Existing wasm32 table-bearing protocol fixture path preserved
Both wasm64 lanes reject table-bearing images with explicit ReadyToRun diagnostic
limitations: Minimal version-2 protocol fixtures contain four known payload bytes, not a real managed WebCIL image.
Native Memory64 fixture was constructed for the probe; current WebcilWasmWrapper only emits the memory32 IL wrapper.
No CLR startup, interpreter guest, GC, high-address heap, real R2R or UE packaging acceptance.
Emscripten 6.0.10 still has the independently observed table64 assembler issue; this C stub uses direct C-to-object compilation.
